title: Locate (or reimplement) the #739 zero-execution scorer change, then update pins, stale expectations and results
body:
## Goal
Finish the #739 zero-execution scorer fix. #754 found that commit 5db2610e (named in the #739 report) is empty: `git diff --name-status 2c2150bf 5db2610e` prints nothing, so nothing could be restored. The #739 report gives the identity of the real change: score.py SHA256 changed from 810a5457c3c32ff8c856ae3d960ea06a495860b1efa5c78a8a895610eb649aac to 296e2354e312d5a69fe62e9629bc085376c0fa523fbf21ad6601fdf1dad8def8 at HEAD 2f91dff53e5e97e5269455aa9d8856bb7e7f9209; behaviour: `compute` in benchmark/scripts/score.py returns `unverified` instead of `correct` when executed<=0, scored<=0, or evidence_record.native_run is present and null; regression_self_test gains zero-executed and zero-scored cases; note benchmark/challenges/scorer-fix-0165.md. Expected gain: the change merged with consistent pins, fixture expectations and regenerated benchmark/results/challenges.json, recorded in benchmark/challenges/scorer-finish-0170.md. No session can run LabVIEW; claim no native behaviour.
Steps: (0) First turn run `python3 -I -c print(1)`; on a tool error write .session/report.md as blocked with the exact error and stop. (1) Locate: `git tag --list iter/0165/*`, `git branch --all --list *739*`, `git log --all --format=%H -n 20 -- benchmark/scripts/score.py`. For each candidate, a helper script in .session/artifacts/ computes SHA256 of `git show <c>:benchmark/scripts/score.py` and compares it with 296e2354... Do not run `git show 5db2610e` again. (2) If a match is found, restore score.py (and scorer-fix-0165.md if present there) from that commit through the helper. If none matches by turn 12, reimplement the change described above in score.py by hand with targeted Edits and record `reimplemented` in `## Source`. (3) Grep every pin of score.py (and other changed files) in benchmark/*.json and update each hash in this task. (4) Every helper that imports or runs score.py starts with faulthandler.dump_traceback_later(60, exit=True), reopens stdin on os.devnull and runs with `python3 -I` (method: benchmark/challenges/scorer-stall-0168.md). Compare fixture `expected` with generate() output; update stale expectations only where caused by the change, and list each. (5) Add a self-test case that isolates native_run null with positive executed and scored. (6) Only then call main() once to rewrite benchmark/results/challenges.json. On a stall: record faulthandler frames, do not rerun unchanged, report partial with saved files.
## Acceptance
- [ ] benchmark/challenges/scorer-finish-0170.md has sections headed exactly `## Source`, `## Restored`, `## Pins`, `## Expectations`, `## Checks`; `## Source` names the commit found (with its score.py SHA256) or says `reimplemented` with the candidates checked.
- [ ] score.py returns `unverified` for executed<=0, scored<=0, and native_run present and null; the regression self-test covers all three, native_run null in isolation.
- [ ] Every pin of a changed file in benchmark/*.json matches the file's new SHA256.
- [ ] Each changed fixture expectation is listed with its reason; benchmark/results/challenges.json was regenerated by main() and parses as JSON; quality_measured stays false.
- [ ] No evaluator, network, model, reader or native call; no commit (the parent commits).
## Verification
python3 -I -c "import json; json.load(open('benchmark/results/challenges.json')); t=open('benchmark/challenges/scorer-finish-0170.md').read().splitlines(); assert all(h in t for h in ('## Source','## Restored','## Pins','## Expectations','## Checks')); print('OK')"
## Context
- Reports of #739, #751, #754 are staged; check .session/exports/manifest.json first.
- benchmark/challenges/scorer-stall-0168.md: the working probe method; an importlib load-and-print helper stalled in #747.
- #739 Discoveries: all 33 fixture controls declare zero execution, so generate() gives 5 matches / 28 mismatches after the change; that is the expected stale set to update.
- benchmark/writing/check_c1_challenges_0125.py is invalidated (#544): never run it. Commands are argv strings without shell expansion; write helper scripts with Write, no long inline -c one-liners.
## Budget
- Reads: the three reports; scorer-stall-0168.md; short git listings (at most 20 lines each); Grep matches in benchmark/*.json; score.py around compute and regression_self_test only (at most 120 lines). No whole fixture or results JSON; print short diffs.
- Source decided by turn 12, pins by turn 18, expectations by turn 30, main() by turn 36, note and report by turn 44.

title: Review the merged zero-execution scorer finish (changed scope only)
body:
## Goal
Review, do not fix. Check that the finish of the #739 zero-execution change is correct and consistent: score.py returns `unverified` for executed<=0, scored<=0, or native_run present and null; pins in benchmark/*.json match file hashes; each changed fixture expectation follows from the change and nothing else; results regenerated. Expected gain: a CLEAR or NOT-CLEAR verdict with numbered findings in .session/report.md that the next shaper reads to close or correct this scope. No session can run LabVIEW.
## Acceptance
- [ ] First turn: a tool probe (`python3 -I -c print(1)`); on failure report blocked with the exact error.
- [ ] The report pins the reviewed commit (`git rev-parse HEAD`) and SHA256 of benchmark/scripts/score.py, benchmark/preparation.json and benchmark/results/challenges.json, computed by the reviewer.
- [ ] Each changed fixture expectation listed in benchmark/challenges/scorer-finish-0170.md is checked against score.py logic, with a verdict per item.
- [ ] Verdict CLEAR or NOT-CLEAR with numbered findings in .session/report.md; detailed evidence in .session/artifacts/; no repository file written.
## Verification
python3 -I -c "t=open('benchmark/challenges/scorer-finish-0170.md').read().splitlines(); assert '## Checks' in t; print('OK')"
## Context
- benchmark/challenges/scorer-finish-0170.md (the producer's note), benchmark/challenges/scorer-stall-0168.md (probe method: faulthandler guard, stdin on devnull, python3 -I).
- Never call score.py main(); generate() only, through a guarded helper in .session/artifacts/. Never run benchmark/writing/check_c1_challenges_0125.py. No evaluator, network, model or native calls.
## Budget
- Reads: the two notes; `git log -n 3 -- benchmark/scripts/score.py` and the diff of score.py against its previous version, at most 200 lines; Grep of pins in benchmark/*.json; fixture entries named in the note only. No whole results JSON.
- Verdict draft by turn 20, report by turn 26.
